messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT P1 — GPU pool 'prod-gpu-pool-1' reports 100% utilization, queue growth, autoscaler failing to launch new instances. Paging oncall @Alex and @Ops SRE. https://redwood.incidents/1799004321
Alex: ack, oncall here. seeing high queue depth on gpu-router. starting triage.
Ops SRE: logs show repeated max scale error from autoscaler: 
```
  ERROR autoscaler: failed to provision nodes: quotaExceeded: CPUs in project
  error: failed to allocate instance group "prod-gpu-ig-1"; reached regional quota
```
Ops SRE: also seeing many model workers with long tail latency — KV cache miss rate spiked to 85% in the last 10m.
Maria: noted. any recent deploys that could affect batching/cache?
Jess: pushed a runtime config change ~03:40 UTC to continuous-batching flags (enable=true, max_batch_tokens=16384) for a perf experiment. rolling back now.
Alex: good call. rollback started. command: `infra deploy-config --service=runtime --env=prod --tag=rollback-2026-03-14`
Sachin: I’m watching the queue metrics. qdepth was 0 -> 24k requests in 6m. 429s increasing for customers using /v1/generate.
Luis: customer impact: two enterprise tenants on dedicated pools reported 15-30% error rate and timeouts. Putting together list.
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident opened: PD-INC-84521, routed to SRE escalation policy.
Alex: mitigation plan: 1) rollback batching params (in flight) 2) increase autoscaler max from 20->30 nodes (temp) 3) route traffic for heavy routes to fallback model redwood-small-quantized in us-west while we stabilize.
Ops SRE: issuing autoscaler patch to raise max nodes. kubectl patch command applied to autoscaler group.
Ops SRE: autoscaler logs now show scale-up requests accepted, but instance creation still failing with quota error for GPUs specifically.
Jess: we can also toggle continuous batching off per pod: `kubectl set env deploy/runtime-runtime CONTINUOUS_BATCHING=false` — preparing rollout to 50% first.
Maria: rolling disable on 50% of pods now to avoid sudden throughput drop.
Sachin: after initial rollback, tail latency for GPUs dropped from 2.1s -> 1.2s on affected pods. but overall qdepth still high because many requests stuck in front of queue.
Alex: re-routing rule applied: traffic heavy-prefix `/v1/generate/long` -> redwood-small-quantized in regional pool `fallback-usw2`. Confirmed 20% of heavy requests diverted.
Luis: customer update being drafted: short note, explaining degraded API latency and mitigation.
Jess: continuous-batching flag fully rolled back at 1799005360.
Ops SRE: after rollback, KV prefix-cache miss rate dropped to 12% from 85% over ~6m. throughput recovered on most nodes.
Sachin: queue draining, qdepth went 24k -> 3.2k in 12m. error rate falling.
Alex: verifying autoscaler: we still have GPU quota error for adding more instances. Raised a quota request with cloud provider and applied temporary soft-limit increases for existing nodes.
Maria: handoff note: I will take post-stabilization follow-ups. Alex handing off oncall at 07:15 UTC.
Alex: handoff ack. leaving escalation notes in incident doc.
Ops SRE: customer impact summary: ~18 minutes of elevated 429s for 4 enterprise tenants, estimated 0.4% of overall requests in the period. Most errors were 429/throttle and some 504s during queue overflow.
Luis: posted customer comms draft to #support-drafts. please review before send.
Jess: root cause hypothesis: config regression enabling aggressive continuous batching increased batch token windows and prevented timely dispatch; combined with large prefix-cache miss spikes (likely due to the batching change) increased per-request GPU time and saturated pool. autoscaler couldn't recover due to GPU quota and max nodes cap.
Sachin: temporary mitigations that worked: rollback batching config, route heavy traffic to smaller model, partial disable continuous batching, raise autoscaler max.
Alex: timeline note for postmortem: 03:40 config change -> 03:47 queue spike starts -> 03:50 incident-bot page -> 03:55 rollback initiated -> 04:12 partial stabilization -> 04:30 mostly recovered.
Ops SRE: creating incident ticket and assigning follow-ups:
- verify batching e2e tests and add guardrails (assignee: Jess, due: 2026-03-18)
- add autoscaler alert when scale requests fail due to quota (assignee: Sachin, due: 2026-03-16)
- improve prefix-cache regression monitoring (assignee: Maria, due: 2026-03-17)
- customer postmortem note and outreach (assignee: Luis, due: 2026-03-15)
Maria: adding one more action: add deploy-time checklist to block continuous-batching flag changes without canary and perf smoke. (assignee: Alex, due: 2026-03-16)
Alex: thanks all. closing page once oncall handoff completes and no regressions in 1h.
incident-bot: Incident marked as "stabilized" at 1799006666. Postmortem link: https://redwood.incidents/postmortems/1799004321
